The '''Savarian Swoop Track robbery''' was a robbery that was perpetrated by an eight-man gang at the [[Savarian Swoop Track]]. The [[Exchange]]'s interests were targeted in the robbery, leading them to issue to a [[Bounty/Legends|bounty]] on the group.
